Strategy: Use the winning band only for mid-size items between thirty and seventy, rewarding leftovers between twenty-eight and forty-two; other items use Best Fit. It may help by focusing the band where it fits the item scale, but may fail if the band would also help other sizes.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if item >= 30 and item <= 70 and r - item >= 28 and r - item <= 42 else 0) for r in bins]
```
